method.name: frozen_sha256_first_byte_parity
method.input: The sha256 field is the frozen counterbalancing digest for each pair.
method.rule: An even first byte runs N then L; an odd first byte runs L then N.
method.reason: Preserve the measured serial N/L order when release task identifiers are normalized to the paper notation.

order_scope: counterbalanced serial execution order within each N/L pair
